entry_points.summary: Command definition: pre-implementation plan audit pipeline; read-only; emits PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md

Merge/synthesize findings + Class tagging: every surviving finding tagged spec_gap or premise_failure using z-review-all.md:716 enum; PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md written with **Class:** field after **Severity:**
Gate & Action: config.py resolve-question workflow.audit_to_amend + amend-gate-decision.py -> auto_split (default) / force_ask / halt
Resolver envelope piped to amend-gate-decision.py; gate token dispatches auto_split/force_ask/halt branches
auto_split: INTENT-mode batches all spec_gap into ONE /z-amend call; legacy-mode per-finding; premise_failure rendered via amendment-brief.py as conversational prose; no popup
force_ask: fires ONLY when amend-gate-decision.py returns force_ask (explicit user preference); 3-way popup: Amend Plan / Proceed as-is / Reject & Re-plan
Elevation proposer: workflow preference elevation check after gate resolves

invariants: command is read-only: never edits active codebase files; all changes go through /z-amend or /z-plan
every surviving finding in PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md must have a **Class:** field immediately after **Severity:**
Class values are restricted to spec_gap or premise_failure for audit-plan findings; correction/approach are glosses only
discriminator is Class not severity: a BLOCKER can be spec_gap or premise_failure
Phase 5 default (source==none) is auto_split — no popup; fresh users never see the 3-way popup
force_ask fires ONLY when amend-gate-decision.py returns force_ask (explicit config/memory preference with ask|prefill)
INTENT-mode auto_split batches ALL spec_gap corrections into ONE /z-amend call (one contract re-freeze)
legacy-mode auto_split invokes one /z-amend --skip-user-gate per spec_gap finding
completed ([x]) tasks are skipped in the auto_split amend loop
halt gate token causes immediate abort via Run Brief halt-finalize path
audit_auto_split telemetry event emitted on every auto_split path execution
gotchas: workflow.audit_to_amend semantics are SOURCE-KEYED: source==none -> auto_split regardless of result value; stored ask/prefill from config|memory -> force_ask
INTENT-mode one-batch constraint is not optional: N separate /z-amend calls on an INTENT target would re-freeze the contract N times and invalidate TASKS.md each time
the 3-way popup (Amend Plan / Proceed as-is / Reject & Re-plan) is preserved but fires only on force_ask — most runs never see it
PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md is written to both $BASE/ and $BASE/archive/$RUN/; the archive copy is for the run-brief pipeline
Phase 5 run-brief populates outcome/next; the approach section prefers extractable bullets from PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md, falls back to a seed file
Class enum source is z-review-all.md:716 — audit-plan does NOT define its own enum; keep in sync
